disabled.title: Encoders are disabled on this server
disabled.body: Field-device pairing is off by default. Set the variable below in the core's .env and restart it to pair encoders by code.

claim.title: Add an encoder
claim.subtitle: Start pairing on the encoder: it shows an 8-character code (valid 10 minutes). Type it here to bind the encoder to this app.
claim.codeHint: Case and dashes don't matter. 5 wrong codes lock you out for a while.
claim.done: {{name}} claimed — it connects as soon as it picks up its credential.

list.empty: No encoders in this app yet.

device.rebootConfirm: Reboot {{name}}? Its channels stop until it comes back.
device.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? Its credential stops working and its channels' stream keys are deleted. To use it again, pair it again.

channels.none: The encoder has not announced any channel yet (it does on connect).
channels.unlinkConfirm: Unlink this channel? Its stream key is deleted.
